items.statement: Promoters will not participate in the share buyback, which will be open only to public shareholders.
items.quote: And one important thing of about the buyback that you should know is that the promoters will not be participating in it. So the entire buyback will be open only to the public shareholders, which is also adding a lot of value to it.

items.statement: Company expects to receive INR 500 crores by January 2027, INR 300 crores by March 2027, and balance INR 354 crores over 12-18 months.
items.quote: The breakup of the INR1,154 crores is expected as follows. We expect that before January of 2027, we should receive approximately INR500 crores. Before March of 2027, we should receive approximately INR300 crores, which makes it approximately INR800 crores. And the balance, INR354 crores, will be received in various tranches over the next 12 to 18 months.

items.statement: Out of first INR 500 crore tranche, INR 190-200 crores allocated for taxes and closing bank limits, INR 200 crores for buyback and special dividend, INR 100 crores for chemical and EPC expansion.
items.quote: Out of the IINR500 crores that the company will get in and about January of 2027, we will be paying taxes. And whatever the limits we have currently with the banks will be closed. That allocation will be approximately INR190 crores to INR200 crores. Apart from this, the company will do a share buyback and a special dividend, the combined allocation towards which, as of now planned, is approximatel

items.statement: Chemical business reported INR 60 crores turnover and INR 6 crores profit in June quarter; expected to cross INR 20 crores PAT for full year with existing capacity.
items.quote: In this quarter , in June quarter, chemical has done a turnover of almost 60 crores, and against that, there was a profit of INR6 crores. So at that rate, you can assume that it will continue. So with the existing capacity, we are going to cross 20 crore s this year for chemical.

items.statement: EPC revenue expected around INR 50-60 crores for current year, rising to INR 250 crores per annum from next year with KKR order.
items.quote: This year financially, it's around INR50 crores, INR60 crores because it's a seasonal thing. But from next year onwards, obviously, with this KKR thing, our yearly EPC revenue will be around, along with the other EPC contracts, it will be crossed around INR250 crores per annum.

items.statement: Completed acquisition of ACT Group's cable TV business for INR35.55 crores on September 15, 2026
items.quote: We successfully completed the acquisition of cable television business of seven companies belonging to the ACT Group on September 15, 2026, for an aggregate cash consideration of INR35.55 crores.

items.statement: Announced acquisition of remaining 74% stake in DL GTPL Cabnet for INR83.25 million
items.quote: GTPL announced the acquisition of the remaining 74% stake in DL GTPL Cabnet for INR83.25 million.

items.statement: Consolidated total income grew 19% year-on-year to INR11,464 million in Q2 FY27
items.quote: for Q2 FY27, consolidated total income stood at INR11,464 million compared with INR9,649 million in Q2 FY26, translating into year-on-year growth of 19%

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA stood at INR1,103 million with reported EBITDA margin of 9.6%
items.quote: Consolidated EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR1,103 million with reported EBITDA margin of 9.6%.

items.statement: Operational EBITDA margin at 20% in Q2 FY27, down from 22% in Q2 FY26 and Q1 FY27
items.quote: The operational EBITDA margin stood at 20% this quarter.

items.statement: Consolidated PAT negative INR50 lakh due to INR75 million additional impact from forex loss and transponder amortization
items.quote: The consolidated PAT stands negative INR50 lakh in this quarter due to additional impact of INR75 million, which is INR45 million on account of forex loss and INR30 million amortization impact due to seven new transponders.

items.statement: Standalone total revenue grew 25% year-on-year to INR8,003 million in Q2 FY27
items.quote: total revenue for this quarter stood at INR8,003 million compared with INR6,402 million in Q2 FY26, representing year-on-year growth of 25%

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA stood at INR667 million in Q2 FY27
items.quote: EBITDA stood at INR667 million.

items.statement: Broadband ARPU increased to INR470 in Q2 FY27 from INR465 year-on-year
items.quote: Broadband ARPU for Q2 FY27 stood at INR470

items.statement: Operating EBITDA margin expected to improve by 150-250 basis points by end of FY27
items.quote: we are looking forward that by the end of the year, we will adding 150 basis points to 250 basis points on those EBITDAs, operating EBITDAs.

items.statement: DSO increased to 80 days due to fast growth and customer approval delays; expects normalization to 65-70 days in next two quarters
items.quote: So, the DSO has gone up to 80 days, and that's due to fast growth and some delays in customer approvals.

items.statement: Unbilled receivables rose due to quick ramp-up, delayed POs and customer payments; rectified in September with normalization expected in Q3 and Q4
items.quote: We had a very quick ramp -up and there were some instances where the POs were delayed and at the same time, there were some customer payment s delayed, but all that has now been rectified.

items.statement: CFO says company keeps minimum Rs 100 cr cash for seasonal needs; cost of funds is ~5% after 3% interest subvention, cheaper than bank offers of 6-8.25%
items.quote: See, our industry is a seasonal industry and we want to keep a minimum of around 100 crores in our hands in order to and to go over our cost of funds is very cheaper. It is only a 5% as compared to banks offer of six by 8.25 because of So, interest subsidy, interest sub tension 3% is there.

items.statement: CMD says surplus funds target returns above 10%, higher than borrowing cost of ~5.25%
items.quote: Our surplus funds, we learn much more than this 5.25%. The finance division has a target to go beyond 10% on this. So, we are doing pretty well with the surplus funds.

items.statement: Board approved merger of 100%-owned SKM Universal into listed company; effective April next year
items.quote: As far as the SKM Universal market is concerned, today the board has passed a resolution to merge the company. with our company. So by April next year, this will become universal company will cease to exist. It will be only as our listed company will handle all the operations.

items.statement: Board approved term loan of nearly Rs 300 cr (Rs 200 cr from State Bank, Rs 100 cr from Axis Bank) for capex; documents to be signed next week
items.quote: the board has also approved a term loan of nearly 300 crores, 200 from State Bank. 100 crores from Access Bank. So, we will be signing the documents next week.

items.statement: CMD says total debt will be about Rs 450 cr during high investment phase
items.quote: we totally about 450 crore debt. we will have.

items.statement: Operating cash flow expected to exceed INR30 crores for the full financial year.
items.quote: you can expect that the operating cash flows to be more than INR30 crores for the financial year.

items.statement: Receivable turnover improved from 145 to 135 days.
items.quote: Just to give a feedback, on an overall basis, the receivable turnover has im proved from 145 to 135 days

items.statement: ESOPs granted to senior hires on a performance basis to aid retention.
items.quote: So with some, we have done with incentivizing them, somebody we have given ESOPs. So this way, we try to retain them for a longer period.

items.statement: Company purchased land worth Rs 12 crore from promoter; land already in use for operations and workers' colony
items.quote: It's just this transaction, we thought of getting it through in the current period. So, it's already been used in our operations, as well as our worker s’ colony. So, it's already been in use with us. And we thought of buying it from our promoter

items.statement: Management has no plan to reduce debt; operating cash flow will be used for capex if new product succeeds
items.quote: If the new product succeeds, then we will need capex. We will need to go for capex.

items.statement: Management reported negative operating cash flow of INR16.51 crores in H1 FY27 due to inventory build-up in new projects.
items.quote: The company has reported a negative operating cash flow of approximately INR16.51 crores in H1 FY27 despite generating actually very healthy profits.

items.statement: Management says cash flow in the first half was very good and they would look to return cash to shareholders via buyback or higher payout if no immediate need arises.
items.quote: Yeah, we would surely be looking at it because if there's not an immediate need for this cash, then we'd like to return it to all our shareholders.

items.statement: Trade receivables were Rs 28.64 crore as of 30 September 2026, highlighting working capital focus.
items.quote: Our inventory was approximately Rs. 16.25 crores, while trade receivables stood at approximately Rs.28.64 crores.

items.statement: Preferential issue underway; Rs 25 crore of Rs 35 crore initial manufacturing capex to be funded from it.
items.quote: That entire CAPEX will not be managed from preferential, we will do the CAPEX o f Rs 25 crores from the preferential issue

items.statement: Board approved a proposed preferential issue of approximately INR312 crores to fund acquisitions and general corporate purposes.
items.quote: On 16th October 2026, the Board approved a proposed preferentia l issue of approximately INR312 crores

items.statement: Cash and bank balance of INR 17.6 crores as of 30th September 2026
items.quote: On cash and balance sheet, we continue to remain a debt -free balance sheet, maintain a debt -free balance sheet with a cash and bank balance of INR 17.6 crores as of 30th September 2026.

items.statement: Management expects positive operating cash flow for FY27 after negative OCF last year
items.quote: This year, definitely we will be seeing a positive cash flow.

items.statement: Receivables increased due to higher turnover; 80% of prior season collections received by Oct-Nov
items.quote: The receivables for whatever happened for the previous season, by October-November, we have received 80% of the payments.

items.statement: Acquiring Hara Communications for Rs 10-15 crore via share swap and bank loan
items.quote: Around like 10 crores to 15 crores.

items.statement: Hara Communications acquisition at asset value; land and software key assets
items.quote: They are selling the whole company at the value of the asset only. So, asset value is itself more than 10 crores.

items.statement: Hara Communications consolidation expected by December after share swap
items.quote: Mostly by the end of November and with that whole share swap and everything should be happened. I think by December it should be reflecting in our balance sheets.

items.statement: Board approved preferential issue of equity and warrants for ~INR100 crore; funds expected by 6 November 2026
items.quote: we are successfully raising approximately INR100 crores through a preferential issue, further strengthening our capital base and providing additional headroom to support a future loan book expansion.

items.statement: Preferential issue funds to be received by 6 November 2026; NSE and BSE principal approval obtained; investors already putting money in escrow
items.quote: The funds are going to come in the third quarter. And this 24.69% is without taking into consider that INR100 crores. So, when the fund will mobilize, which has been expected by 6th of November, we got the principal approval from NSE, BSE.

items.statement: IPO funds being used for capital expansion including machinery purchase and capacity increase at Pithampur and Dewas plants
items.quote: A significant portion of the funds raised through the IPO is intended for capital expansion.

items.statement: Working capital cycle currently 248-249 days, expected to improve to 200-230 days as domestic OEM business grows
items.quote: Our current working capital cycle, including inventory, is approximately 248-249 days.
